photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 18:02:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 182 s; on-screen clock 04/13/13 18:02:50, wanted 18:02:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-102  18:02:' on 2013-04-12 (`as run matrix!B98`), read as 2013-04-12 18:02. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-12 plus one day, 18:02: it was found 132 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (42) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('42, 43, 41', `as run matrix!J98`).
